issue.title: File systems tests all fails on the mac machine

labels.name: P0

repository.name: bazel
repository.description: a fast, scalable, multi-language and extensible build system

issue.body:
This is blocking #1056 

Apparently an auto-update totally broke the machine a temporary hack solve the connection problem but now the test suite have several failures on the file system.

Creating this bug to track the issue.

body: Seems to be a borked msys2 installation. I wonder how that's possible given that the machine has been installed anew. I'll add `pacman -Syyu --noconfirm` to the instance init script and see what happens.

`pacman -S isl` fixed the immediate problem. Next one is a mysterious stack trace in the proto compiler, but I sort of hope that this is some sort of transient because Jenkins decided to start a build while I was reimaging the slave.

Sigh.
Turns out, `protoc-mingw.exe` dumps core when invoked even without arguments. Maybe something changed in msys2 that made these binaries incompatible?

Copying `protoc-windows-x86_64.exe` over as `protoc-mingw.exe` seems to work. @dslomov says that that other binary exists because it works for paths longer than 1024 characters, but I'd rather live with that limitation if it means one less binary in third_party (and that without reproduction instructions...)

This is broken again:

http://ci.bazel.io/job/Bazel/JAVA_VERSION=1.7,PLATFORM_NAME=windows-x86_64/424/console

My guess is that it's 585c87b0fce06a452976ce0d0a3091b28ed01dbd .
